scope: The modern Saint Sebastian Co-Cathedral in the Santa Helena neighborhood of Coronel Fabriciano as seen in June 2010. The building has a broad triangular glazed gable, three folded side bays, and a low covered central entry.

references.filename: Fachada da Catedral de São Sebastião, Coronel Fabriciano MG.JPG

originalReview.notes: The frontal view shows the tent-shaped face, weathered tan walls, orange metal trim, broad triangular glazing with crisscross frames, a vertical lower glazed strip, and the entrance canopy.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact first-party public-domain Qualla original with a native self-dedication from the credited photographer.
